about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: More than code, I create solutions that make people's lives easier

history.title: My Story
history.paragraph1: My passion for programming started in high school when I discovered Scratch. Seeing how simple instructions came to life and created something functional fascinated me from the very first moment.
history.paragraph2: With over 3 years of professional experience, I have worked on e-commerce, multi-tenant SaaS, conversational AI and blockchain applications. But what really motivates me every day is not the technologies themselves, but the real impact they have on people.

passion.title: What Drives Me
passion.paragraph1: What I'm most passionate about is creating projects that people actually use. I'm not satisfied with something that just "works" technically; I want it to make people's lives easier, more efficient, more enjoyable.
passion.paragraph2: Every time I see end users interact with an application I developed and receive positive feedback from the team, I know I'm doing what I love. That's my goal: solving real problems with technology.

hobbies.title: Outside of Code
hobbies.item1: Passionate about padel - nothing better than disconnecting on the court
hobbies.item2: Amateur runner - currently training for several races
hobbies.item3: The discipline of running helps me keep a clear mind for solving complex problems

location.title: Why Alicante
location.description: I live in Alicante because everything that matters is here: my family, my friends and an incredible climate that allows me to train outdoors all year round.
location.seeking: I'm looking for opportunities in tech companies where I can add value, work in teams and continue growing professionally in a challenging environment.

experience.title: Professional Experience
experience.subtitle: Full Stack Developer with experience in tech companies across Alicante and Murcia. Specialized in React, Next.js, Node.js and applied AI — conversational agents and SaaS products — with a track record working in international teams.

nanoninoCurrent.description: Second stage at the company, building Talkrev, a multi-tenant conversational AI SaaS platform (chat, real-time voice and bookings), and PartsNow.ai, its agentic-commerce product for heavy-duty truck and trailer parts.
achievements: Built Talkrev, a multi-tenant conversational AI SaaS platform with chat and real-time voice, including the agent dashboard and the "Turno" booking suite
Built a RAG pipeline to ground the agents on each client's knowledge base
Implemented the conversational and real-time voice agents, plus integrations with other AI agents
Built PartsNow.ai: AI commerce for truck parts with search by chat, voice, photo or VIN over a 50,000+ parts catalog with unified checkout
Integrated payment gateways and automated shipping, with a cloud backend and continuous deployment

nanonino.description: Development of web and blockchain applications, working with international teams in India and Spain.
achievements: Developed progressive web applications with good performance handling large data volumes
Implemented smart contracts optimizing digital interactions and transactions on blockchain
Created AI-powered booking system for golf courses with voice and chat interactions
Developed CBD products e-commerce with landing page, catalog and advanced search with Algolia
Collaborated effectively with multicultural teams in India and Spain

evvant.description: Development of complete booking system, ensuring scalability and security with continuous performance improvements.
achievements: Created complete booking system with ReactJS and NodeJS optimized for scalability and security
Implemented dynamic interactive map that facilitated unit selection and booking
Developed key functionalities to purchase, cancel and modify bookings easily
Applied continuous performance optimizations ensuring speed and better UX
Delivered robust solution that significantly improved user experience

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.metaDescription: Privacy policy for Raúl Berná's portfolio: what data is collected, purpose, legal basis, user rights, and processors (Vercel, Resend, Upstash). GDPR and LOPDGDD compliant.
privacy.intro: This policy explains what personal data this site collects, for what purpose, and what rights you have over it, in accordance with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR) and Spanish Organic Law 3/2018 (LOPDGDD).
privacy.controllerBody: Raúl Berná Riera · Tax ID: [to be completed] · Alicante, Spain · raulbernariera99@gmail.com
privacy.dataBody: Only what you voluntarily enter in the contact form: your name, your email address and the content of your message. In addition, your IP address is temporarily recorded for the sole purpose of limiting the number of submissions and preventing abuse of the form.
privacy.purposeBody: Exclusively to read your message and reply to you. It is not used to send you marketing communications, no profiling is carried out and no automated decisions are made.
privacy.legalBasisBody: Your explicit consent, given by ticking the checkbox in the form before submitting it (art. 6.1.a GDPR). You may withdraw it at any time by writing to the address above.
privacy.retentionBody: Your message is kept in the controller's mailbox for as long as needed to handle your enquiry, and for a reasonable period afterwards as a record of the exchange. You may request its deletion at any time. The IP address used for submission control is discarded after a few minutes.
privacy.processorsBody: The following providers are used, all of them with GDPR compliance guarantees: Vercel Inc. (site hosting), Resend (delivery of the form email) and Upstash (temporary submission-rate control). Your data is not shared with any other third party and is never sold.
privacy.analyticsBody: This site uses Vercel Analytics and Vercel Speed Insights to measure visits and page performance. These tools use no cookies and collect no personally identifiable data: the information is aggregated anonymously.
privacy.chatBody: The site's assistant processes your messages through a language model in order to reply to you. They are not linked to your identity and are not stored permanently. Even so, we recommend not entering sensitive personal information in the chat.
privacy.rightsBody: You may exercise your rights of access, rectification, erasure, objection, restriction of processing and portability by writing to raulbernariera99@gmail.com. If you believe your data has not been handled properly, you may lodge a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency (aepd.es).

cookies.title: Cookie policy
cookies.metaDescription: Cookie policy for Raúl Berná's portfolio: only a technical cookie (NEXT_LOCALE) is used to remember language preference, exempt from consent. No tracking, advertising or third-party analytics cookies.
cookies.intro: Short version: this site uses no tracking, advertising or third-party analytics cookies, which is why no consent banner is shown.
cookies.ownBody: A single technical cookie is used, NEXT_LOCALE, which remembers whether you prefer the site in Spanish or English. It is essential for the language switcher to work and is exempt from consent under article 22.2 of the LSSI-CE.
cookies.thirdBody: Vercel Analytics and Speed Insights, which measure visits and performance, work without cookies and collect no identifying data.
cookies.manageBody: You can delete or block cookies from your browser settings. Since this is only a language cookie, blocking it will simply mean the site does not remember your preference between visits.
